feature_contract.goal: Preserve un-stretched title and car selection menu sprites on desktop wide and portrait XR viewports, including non-origin rotation/scale pivots and complete matrix translation.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only front-end 2D D3DX menu/car-selection matrix transformation under KeepCentered/OnlineArcade; leave gameplay HUD, world draw, F11, flare, SkyGlow, original pointer/return and Vanilla unchanged.
trace_stages: Original main/title/car-selection producer passes 2D pivot and scale to D3DXMatrixTransformation2D.
Game UI scaler composes min-axis containment with the complete resulting transform, preserving rotation and pivot offsets.
The source D3D9 sprite matrix drives menu draw and stereo HUD/eye presentation without unrelated scope widening.
subcomponents: Post-D3DX affine composition for pivoted and rotated title/menu/car-selection sprites across width/height.
Keep existing nonpivoted full/partial input-vector paths, Vanilla and non-front-end exact owners isolated with finite fail-closed fallback.
Compile-time multi-axis rotation/translation/native-aspect regression assertions and exact-SHA Win32 gate.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Game title and car-select original D3DX sprite matrix
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Rotated or pivoted sprites use one min-axis aspect containment on both transformed axes, including offset and rotation center.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Nonpivot and unrelated game/VR render ownership
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Native 4:3 remains identity; Vanilla, world/HUD/F11 and nonpivoted paths retain their original behavior, and invalid matrix preserves original.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: DX9Ex R84 Win32 game and OpenXR host
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Exact validation-bearing source SHA succeeds in Active game/full-chain/host/package, Domain and affected Source Impact gates; headset proof separate.

diagnosis.original_evidence: The original D3DXMatrixTransformation2D hook rescales input pScaling and pTranslation independently, but forwards unscaled pScalingCenter and pRotationCenter whenever supplied.
diagnosis.root_cause: Input-only viewport containment does not compose the entire D3DX 2D transform when a source sprite has scaling or rotation pivots, leaving pivot-origin translation on mismatched axes.
source_trace: Original title/car-selection sprites call hooked D3DXMatrixTransformation2D with nullable scale, translation and pivot parameters.
Source method previously rewrote only scale/translation before D3DX computed the pivoted affine matrix.
D3D9 uses that affine matrix for source UI sprite placement; R84 per-eye ownership is downstream and not changed.
alternatives_rejected: Do not globally alter render-target viewport, eye projection, F11 glyph atlas, or world WVP to correct a front-end-only producer transform.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: For pivoted menu geometry, call original D3DX first then compose output matrix with min-axis aspect scaling plus X/Y centering; retain all nonpivot paths.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: C++ static_asserts cover rotated X/Y matrix coefficients and native 4:3 identity, and conditional gating excludes Vanilla/gameplay/HUD.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: The original 2D menu sprite matrix is corrected before the existing R84 per-eye compositor; no per-eye world or SkyGlow owner changes.

runtime_evidence: No Quest3/VDXR HMD verification in this run.
